in_sanskrit.name: पुरूरवा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who loves the multitude; one who loves many

in_hindi.name: पुरूरवा
in_hindi.long_meaning: प्रबुध्द और समुदाय के प्यारे व्यक्ति

in_marathi.name: Pururava
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pururava हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Pururava was an ancient king, son of Ila and Budha, husband of Urvashi in Hindu mythology.

in_bengali.name: Pururava
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Ancient King
in_bengali.long_meaning: Pururava একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Pururava was an ancient king, son of Ila and Budha, husband of Urvashi in Hindu mythology.
